name: Deployment & Transition
one_liner: Make the system deployable, and make the organisation ready to receive it.
purpose: Whatever approach is applied, there is always a need to ensure the information system under development can effectively be deployed in the organisation's technical infrastructure; the Operational Model describes those technical and infrastructure aspects. Alongside the technical side, several considerations enable a smooth business transition — user testing, frequent training and communication sessions all raise engagement. Deployment and transition activities are also crucial for taking dependencies with other projects and information systems into account.
meta: 4.14 — the last of the fourteen themes

fields.what: Regardless of the approach applied, the system under development must be effectively deployable in the organisation's technical infrastructure.
fields.pollux: The portal must run in ESM's infrastructure, not only in the team's environment.

fields.what: Describes all the technical and infrastructure related aspects of deploying the information system.
fields.pollux: Einstein's model covers hosting for national-authority access.

fields.what: Several considerations must be evaluated together with the technical aspect of deployment to enable a smooth business transition.
fields.pollux: Hopper's client-side coordination matters as much as the release itself.

fields.what: User testing is one of the activities that leads to an increased level of engagement ahead of transition.
fields.pollux: The four analysts test the portal against their own quarter-end routine.

fields.what: Frequent training is named as an activity that increases the users' level of engagement.
fields.pollux: Reporting staff are trained before the 31 Jan 2030 transition.

fields.what: Communication sessions also raise engagement, keeping the user community connected to the delivery.
fields.pollux: Sessions ahead of each of the four releases, not only at the end.

fields.what: Ensuring users are continually informed and aligned with the project delivery schedule allows optimal delivery of the solution.
fields.pollux: Users know a quarterly release cadence and plan around it.

fields.what: Deployment and transition activities are crucial to ensure dependencies with other projects and information systems are taken into account.
fields.pollux: The portal depends on the CASTOR lending platform staying live.

fields.what: For further information the guide refers to the PM² guide on managing Transitions and Business Implementation.
fields.pollux: PM²-Agile does not replace PM²'s transition machinery on POLLUX.

fields.what: Created by the Team Coordinator aligned with the release schedule and the project-level Transition Plan, with the PM accountable.
fields.who: TeCo responsible; ATeMs and ArOw support
fields.pollux: Lovelace writes it; you approve it; it feeds the transition.

fields.what: A representative of the relevant operational unit contributes operational process and infrastructure information and checks feasibility and risks.
fields.pollux: ESM operations check the portal is supportable before go-live.

fields.what: Deployment and transition is also one of the five themes on which the A-PCT coordinates with other groups.
fields.pollux: Transparency with operations supports configuration management too.

traps: Deployment is not only technical — transition carries the business change.
The Operational Model, not the Architecture Overview, describes deployment infrastructure.
Deployment and Transition is also one of the five external coordination themes.
Dependencies with other projects and systems belong in deployment planning.
PM²-Agile defers here to the PM² Transitions and Business Implementation guide.
